content.welcomeBody: rwthrank compares your examination results with those of other students. Upload your transcript of records to see where you stand.
content.loginHeading: Signing in with a one-time code
content.loginBody: We send an eight-digit code to your email address. No password is required.
content.firstTimeBody: If you are using rwthrank for the first time, your account is created with the first code. There is no separate registration.

form.codeSentTo: We have sent a code to {email}. It is valid for five minutes.

signedIn.label: Signed in as
signedIn.next: Next, upload your transcript of records.

curve.title: Grade distribution
curve.subtitle: Sample data, n = {count}
curve.alt: Bar chart of the grade distribution from 1.0 to 5.0, with the largest share at 2.3.
curve.note: The German scale has no values between 4.0 and 5.0. A 4.0 is the last passing grade.
curve.pending: Your own position appears once you have uploaded a transcript of records.
